verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform. Asking an AI agent in natural language about repositories and open pull requests is a source-control and code-review capability outside its product category. Its AI-adjacent items (the Aperture LLM gateway and CLI for running third-party coding agents, and a Tailscale skill for coding agents) do not show the product itself offering conversational insight into repos or PRs, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can converse with an AI agent in natural language to get insights into repositories and open pull requests
